author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
In this comprehensive tutorial, @JamiePaige redesigns her brand's packaging using #AdobeIllustrator. Knowing that Jamie's parcels are her customer's first impression of her company Jamie Page Doodles, she sets out to craft new wrapping paper and stickers. 

From making vectors that scale up without losing quality to features like Object Pattern and Artboards, watch as she makes the most of Adobe Ilustrator's toolbox.

00:00 - Intro
01:19 - Getting Startedon on Wrapping Paper
02:24 - Creating Vectors
04:37 - Creative Juice
08:54 - Arranging the Design
13:41 - Alternative Colors
15:59 - Designing Stickers
18:01 - Outro
